verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a REST API accessed via API key and curl (docs-1, probe-1), explicitly designed for machine consumption and automation pipelines (docs-26, docs-2), with documented integrations into automation platforms like n8n and Dify for AI agent orchestration (docs-14, docs-38) and an official MCP server for programmatic/headless agent use (docs-15, probe-4).
